rss: Create more jobs for under-25s by cutting National Insurance, key report urges
title: More Jobs for Youngsters!
story: A new plan wants to help young people get more jobs by making it cheaper for companies to hire them. This could mean more fun ways for kids to learn about working!
storyBig: A recent report suggests reducing employment costs to encourage businesses to hire more young people. This initiative may help tackle youth unemployment by making it financially easier for companies to create job opportunities.
think: How can making jobs cheaper for companies help young people find work?
bull: More young people might find fun jobs!
bear: Some companies might still not hire without more incentives.

rss: Beauty advent calendars can cost hundreds but are they value for money?
title: Are Advent Calendars Worth It?
story: Some special holiday calendars cost a lot of money, but are they really worth all those shiny coins? It's fun to get a surprise every day, but it might not always be the best deal!
storyBig: Specialty advent calendars are gaining popularity but come with high price tags. Consumers should weigh the cost against the value of the items inside to decide if they're getting a good deal.
think: Why do people like getting surprises in a daily calendar?
bull: Opening a new surprise each day is super fun!
bear: They might cost more than what's inside is worth.
